pages.title: Transfinite Coil Block
pages.text: A coil of hypernova alloy wound around an aleph-null shard over a cosmic neutronium coil, superconducting at room temperature. It carries a current that never quite finishes counting itself. The windings seem to continue past the point where the coil should end.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Above stellar-core temperatures even cosmic neutronium coils fail. I wound hypernova alloy around an aleph-null shard with a room-temperature superconductor and a cosmic processor, and the coil held.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Transcendence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Pleroma Confluence.
